owner.digest: The owner's desk: what only the owner decides waits here, and is answered in the company card's Owner decisions.

vars.private_patterns: API keys, customer emails, internal host names

product.head: owner
product.digest: Owns WHAT and WHY: priorities, the PRDs, acceptance against the product goal.

vars.verdict_cmd: hub report "ACCEPT #<id>: <how it serves the PRD>" -p PRODUCT_SLUG --agent product (REJECT and the reason when it does not)

cto.head: owner
cto.digest: Owns HOW: specs, acceptance by the spec's tests, the only one who merges to main.

vars.plan_file: the PRDs product has accepted, docs/PRD_*.md
vars.verdict_cmd: hub report "ACCEPT #<id>: <the acceptance command and its result>" -p PRODUCT_SLUG --agent cto (REJECT and the failing test when it fails), then merge

pm.head: product
pm.digest: Owns the funnel and the numbers: metrics, PRDs, copy.

dev.head: cto
dev.digest: Writes code strictly to spec, on a task branch.

reviewer.head: cto
reviewer.digest: Reads the code whole before acceptance: bugs, contract drift, risks.

qa.head: cto
qa.digest: Runs the spec's numbered tests as cases, with evidence.

sre.head: cto
sre.digest: Builds, deploys and runs; fixes the broken build.

runner.head: cto
runner.digest: Rote work by instruction: format, bulk edits, collection.
